explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 64 named tracks, release cuts, reviews and catalogue references across Juno's live September 2026 techno window, the current Monnom Black and Michigander releases, Clergy's emerging split series, Eddie Richards' remastered catalogue circulation, related label catalogues and adjacent electro, dub-techno, minimal, acid and broken-pattern material. Written metadata and attributed descriptions only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Runs 172–198 artist and release fields were not recycled. Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, prior unresolved titles, prior ranked leads, unselected alternates and exact utility-ledger identities were excluded.

The five-run repetition repair excluded Cave → Abundance, Raataja → Crawl and Rabbit Hole → Can I live from the planned top-candidate tests because those boundaries had recently reproduced the same unanswered direction/endpoint question without materially new evidence.

Top slots prioritize exact-track direction or endpoint evidence: Detachment shuts down, Northward ramps tension and Neon Shadows remains in continuous unsettled motion. Lower-ranked leads preserve honest adjacent and overlooked alternatives without padding.
Every placement pair was re-derived from the current 52-track ledger and checked for adjacency. The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer sequence remains untouched.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: Juno's live listings supplied exact tracklists and differentiated exact-track descriptions for Lars Huismann's September 3 System Collapse EP and Luke Hess/Brian Kage's August 27 Northward EP. https://www.juno.co.uk/techno/charts/bestsellers/this-week/?items_per_page=500

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: Clergy Splits 04 supplied exact, individually described tracks from Franco Rossi and Pierce, including cut-loose, ramp-up and shut-down actions. https://www.juno.co.uk/techno/charts/bestsellers/this-week/?items_per_page=500

OVERLOOKED / NEWLY CONTEXTUALIZED WINDOW: Eddie Richards' September 7 remastered Destiny circulation supplied exact track-specific rhythmic and timbral descriptions. https://www.juno.co.uk/techno/charts/bestsellers/this-week/?items_per_page=500
